title: Just in Thyme | Gulf View 30A Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Just In Thyme offers a private pool, pet friendly comfort, bikes, and wraparound balconies just 100 yards to the beach and steps from Seaside.
description_expanded: Just In Thyme Features - 100 Yards to Dogwood/Thyme Beach Access. Beach service available at this location - 2 min bike ride to Seaside shopping and dining, including the famous Seaside Food Trucks - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less.
